path.description: Path to the file to read.

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default: 1).

limit.description: Number of lines to read (default: to end of file). Combine with `offset` to read a slice.

column.description: 1-based byte offset within each line to start reading from (default: full line). Compatible with the column reported by `grep` in content mode. To see context around a match, subtract a margin (e.g. `column = hit_column - 50`).

length.description: Max bytes to read per line from `column` (default: to end of line).
